doc: Preregistration for M6 iterations (docs/BUILD_PLAN.md §0.1, §4 "M6: generality"). One key per iteration under iterations, each in its own source spec/M6/predictions/<key>.json (holon.aggregate writes this aggregate from them). A key is written once, in its prereg commit, before any of its outcome_paths change; holon audit prereg checks the order and that the key is never edited afterwards. predictions count toward prediction accuracy; regressions are outcomes already recorded in the repo that must not change.

I103.title: I103: frontend reach: a pinned solc set chosen by pragma, go 1.25 next to 1.24.7 chosen by the go directive, a deterministic go.work replace rule, and a total sort pass (holon-sort-types/0.3) whose unknown terms are opaque fresh variables and coverage debt; Morph's M0-M3 record moves only by re-stamp
I103.plan: docs/BUILD_PLAN.md (§3, the map row I103; §4 "M6: generality")

thresholds.doc: No number is a gate (BUILD_PLAN §4, M6 exit). Each prediction holds or misses as stated; a miss is reported, never forced.

predictions.claim: No document of I51's 11 not_run entries (c01 c02 c05 c06 c07 c10 c11 c12 c15 c16 c20) is refused for its toolchain any more under the I103 protocol: no reason carries solc's 'requires different compiler version', go's 'go.mod requires go >=' or 'conflicting replacements for'.

Extraction reach: of the 11, exactly the three wormhole Go entries (c06 c11 c16, once the go.work replace conflict is settled by the main module's replace) extract at least one document. The four optimism entries still fail (solc 0.8.15 compiles, but their imports need the monorepo's remappings and submodules, which no protocol rule supplies); the three nitro entries still fail under go 1.25.14 (their packages import generated code the tree does not hold); compound c02 compiles under 0.5.17 and the transitions walker refuses its 0.5 AST on a construct it does not know.
Every document of the 11 that does not extract carries a non-empty reason that is not a Python traceback: it names the missing import, package, toolchain or construct.

The toolchain each entry's documents select, read from the row's toolchain text or reason: compound 0.5.17 (newest pinned release satisfying ^0.5.16), optimism 0.8.15 (an exact pragma), nitro go 1.25.14 (go directive 1.25), wormhole go 1.24.7 (its go directive is at most 1.24.7).

The total sort pass (holon-sort-types/0.3) completes on every committed transitions document (results/M6/i103/sorts_coverage.json: Morph's, I50's and I50b's held-out documents, I51's c17, M5's twelve intent documents and any the I103 corpus run extracts): none is refused.

Coverage debt per head: both held-out documents (I50's and I50b's) carry exactly one unknown head, calldataload, 132 times (I50b's count of its occurrences); Morph's rollup document and c17's carry none.

regressions.claim: Morph's M0-M3 record (results/M0-M3, laws/M0-M3) moves only by re-stamp: every JSON file equals the M6 skeleton commit's with generator_sha256 fields removed, and no other file is added, removed or changed. With the CI gates (M0, M1, M2, partial M3) and holon land dirty showing no law re-made.

Hand sidecars stay authoritative: no committed sidecar outside spec/M6 asks for pragma selection or a go toolchain rule, so every Morph document is extracted by exactly the toolchain it names today (solc 0.8.24, go 1.24.7).
No silent 0.8 semantics: a committed document compiled by a release below 0.8.0 says arithmetic unchecked and holds no overflow panic (code 17).
Determinism: the coverage file is reproduced by re-walking each document (status, debt, debt_heads).
The coverage file covers every git-tracked transitions document under gen/, spec/ and results/, sorted.
Contracts F1-F6: solc pragma selection, the pinned solc and go sets, go selection by directive, the go.work main-module rule and the total sort pass behave as the test file's docstring states.

predictions.claim: Role precision and recall on Morph (holon roles, mode static, over the ten extracted Morph documents, against the 6 role items of the hand sidecars spec/M3/lib/{go_laws,link,go_ops}.json, compared by the facts they name): recall at least 0.5 and precision at least 0.25. Expected: both link roles (header_length by accepted (tag, length) pairs, zero_versioned_hash by equal value and width) and the blob Go-op carrier are found; the recompute role and the gox document are uncertain (no data-flow evidence pairs a Go hash with one Solidity store; several Go documents carry the same functions); precision is lowered by the extra Go-op carriers static inference cannot rule out (reach is a human judgement).

Under --roles auto in a scratch root, at least half of M3's role-dependent decided laws are re-derived (same id, same statement, same status), and every other decided M3 law is unchanged (it reads no role sidecar). New laws (ids the hand roles do not give) are reported with their statuses, never added to M3's record.

Planted wrong roles (a link role pairing facts of different meaning, a Go-op component over a wrong carrier, a recompute role pairing a Go hash with a wrong Solidity store), fed through the proposal channel: no law derived through them is a finding. Each such law is UNKNOWN, PROVED (a true statement about the wrongly paired facts), or REFUTED with a replay that does not confirm, classified role_defect or model_defect; the finding count is 0.

Smoke test, not a score: of I51's 9 extracted corpus entries, at least 5 get at least one role from holon roles and at least 2 derive at least one law (Go-op components are common in Go code; codec pairs and links are rare without a codec frontend match). c03 and c04 stored no document and count as neither.

regressions.claim: Morph's hand sidecars are unchanged and stay authoritative for Morph's record.
No M0-M3 law, record or generated output moves except generator_sha256 (re-stamp only).
holon roles is deterministic and its committed Morph output is what it writes.

thresholds.rederived: a role-dependent decided M3 law is re-derived when, in a scratch root whose spec/M3/lib/{go_laws,link,go_ops}.json are the generated ones (holon roles --install --roles auto), derive writes a law of the same id whose statement is canonically equal and holon run decides it with the hand record's status

thresholds.smoke_inputs: the extracted documents I51 stored under results/eval/holon/<id>/facts/ (no re-extraction; an entry with no stored document counts as no role and no law)

I104.title: I104: role inference. `holon roles` writes the role sidecars (go_laws, link, go_ops) and the typed sidecars for any target from its extracted documents, by a deterministic static inferencer (primary) and an AI proposal channel (data with its sha256, static wins on conflict); every role and every law derived through a generated role carries roles_source. Measured on Morph with --roles auto against the hand sidecars (reported, never substituted), on planted wrong roles (never a finding), and as a smoke test on I51's 9 extracted corpus entries

I105.title: I105: Go state machines: the Go frontend emits transitions documents in the Solidity frontend's IR (struct-field machines first, then constant-prefix KV stores), with writes it cannot model over-approximated as havoc, so the typed pipeline (sorts, types, model, disch, derive) runs unchanged on a Go-only machine

predictions.claim: On the planted fixture (tests_m6/fixtures/i105/src), holon extract go_machines writes one holon-facts/0.3 transitions document (extraction.kind transitions, frontend go) per machine, exactly the five struct types with exported methods (Bank, Alias, Loop, Spawn, Keeper); Bank's families are Bal (mapping), Count, Owner, Paused (scalars); its actions are its eight exported methods; Deposit writes Bal at [[map, [param, who]]] and Count from [storage, Count]; SetPaused writes Paused := [param, p] behind a guard over [param, caller] and [storage, Owner]; Withdraw's guards mention [storage, Paused] and [param, n]; Halt's panic is a guard over [storage, Paused]; the value receiver Credit writes the shared map Bal, Lose (a write to the receiver's copy) and Total write nothing, Total returns [storage, Count]; Tick writes Count through the inlined unexported helper.

Soundness on the planted cases: a write the frontend cannot model is never dropped. Through (a local alias of &a.X) writes X := [param, v] exactly; Leak (&a.Y passed to a dynamic call) writes Y with a havoc value (holding [unknown, ...]); Deref (a write through a pointer read from the state) writes every family (P, X, Y) with havoc values; Fill (writes inside a loop bounded by an argument) writes Arr and N with havoc values and records loop debt, and K := 7 after the loop exactly; Go (a goroutine writing X) writes X with a havoc value, records goroutine debt, and Z := 2 exactly.

The KV-store pattern: the planted Keeper (a field of an interface type with Get/Has/Set/Delete over []byte keys) has the mapping family store; its actions are Balance, Remove, SetBalance; SetBalance writes store at a map key that holds [param, addr] and the prefix constant [str, hex("bal/")], with a value that mentions [param, amt], behind a guard over [param, caller]; Remove deletes (writes 0) at that key behind a guard that reads [storage, store].

The typed pipeline runs unchanged on a Go-only machine: on the Bank document, I51's stages sorts, types, model, disch and derive (holon.eval.holon_run._rules, spec/M4/lib/i51_run.json) all finish ok and derive at least one law.
Two extractions of the planted fixture write the same file names with byte-identical contents.

Smoke measure on I51's Go entries at their prefix commits (results/M6/I105/corpus.json, python -m holon eval go-machines; machines counted over every Go document of the entry, actions summed over its machines): per entry, machines and actions lie in the preregistered ranges [machines_lo, machines_hi, actions_lo, actions_hi] of expected.

Smoke measure: the typed pipeline (sorts, types, model, disch, derive over the entry's transitions documents) completes on at least 1 of the 8 entries; on every other entry the first stage that is not ok is named in refused_at.
Smoke measure: the laws derived over the 8 entries total between 1 and 500.

regressions.claim: The Solidity frontend and the Go codec frontend are unchanged: every file of holon/frontends/solidity/ and holon/frontends/go/ (ssadump's main.go included) hashes to its pin, so every Solidity document and every Go codec document re-extracts byte-identically; the Go machine emitter lives in its own frontend module. Morph's M0-M3 records move by re-stamp only (holon land dirty, reported in docs/iterations/I105.md).

thresholds.smoke: P6-P8 are smoke measures (the brief: I107 scores); a miss is reported, never tuned to

definitions.machine: a named struct type declared in a document package with at least one exported method (value or pointer receiver) declared in that package
definitions.action: an exported method of a machine declared in the package; its walk inlines static calls of functions of the document's packages to the config's inline_depth
definitions.complete: the stages sorts, types, model, disch and derive all finish with status ok over the entry's machine documents
definitions.laws: the L*.json files derive writes to laws/<milestone> for the entry

I106.title: I106: fresh sealed targets by commit-reveal: 2 of 9 preregistered public systems drawn by sha256(salt || blockhash) over the first Ethereum mainnet block at or after T, pinned by ls-remote, and sealed in spec/heldout2/commitment.json until the reveal after I107's prereg

predictions.claim: The seal (c): spec/heldout2/commitment.json is committed with sha256(target.json), the salt_sha256 of this key, T, and the beacon block (number, hash, timestamp, source), the block being the first Ethereum mainnet block whose timestamp is >= T; spec/heldout2/README.md states the sealed state and the sole-reader rule. Neither the salt nor the plaintext is committed before the reveal.

The reveal (d), after I107's prereg: spec/heldout2/target.json and salt.txt are committed; sha256(target.json) and sha256(salt bytes) equal the commitment's and this key's; `python3 spec/M6/lib/I106_draw.py verify` recomputes the seed, the order and the draw of 2 from the committed script and candidates and prints VERIFY OK.

regressions.claim: The draw script imports only the standard library and is deterministic on a fixed test vector; the pin rule behaves as its docstring states; the candidate list meets its form rules; the key pins both sidecars by sha256.

thresholds.counting: P1 and P2 are construction checks of the procedure (they state that the sealer follows it, not a measured property of HOLON); they are reported, and do not count toward prediction accuracy.

seal.beacon_rule: the hash of the first Ethereum mainnet block whose timestamp is >= T_unix
seal.seed_rule: sha256(salt bytes || blockhash bytes), as spec/M6/lib/I106_draw.py defines
seal.sole_reader: Before the reveal nobody reads the plaintext, not the lead and not a builder; after it, only I107 reads the targets (docs/iterations/I49.md's rule).

predictions.claim: Corpus (contaminated): at least 14 of the 20 entries extract at least one document under route A (I51's 11 plus I103's c02, c06 and c16), and no entry is refused only for its toolchain (every failed document's reason names something other than a missing pinned compiler or go release).

Corpus: at most 2 entries derive any law over routes A, B and C together, and route A decides at most 5 laws. Reason: route A's generic sidecars carry zero storage and no binding (I51, I103: 0 laws); route B pins I105's own protocol, whose 0.2 sort pass refused 7 of 8 Go machines on s> and sext (I105 run 2); route C derived 0 laws on 9 entries (I104 P4).
Corpus: 0 of 20 entries are detected against I48's labels (I51's instrument). The deltas are therefore -5 against the agent reviewer (c15, c17-c20) and -1 against slither (c05), the same as I51's.
Corpus: every REFUTED law, if any, is unreplayed (binding null), so the true_defect count is 0.

Sealed: at least 1 of the 2 targets extracts at least one document (a contract whose imports stay inside the target's own tree), and on every target fewer than half of the attempted documents extract (no dependency tree is fetched: an import of a package or submodule fails the compile).

Sealed: on every target with an extracted document, route A's derive completes without refusal (status ok): the total sort pass (holon-sort-types/0.3) turns an unknown term into an opaque variable, where I50's 0.2 pass refused Scroll's whole document on 'update'.

Sealed: at least 1 law is decided (PROVED or REFUTED, the checker's word) on at least 1 target, with zero hand-written target files (no sidecar, role, fact, law, scope list or target file written by hand).

Sealed: every REFUTED law is unreplayed (binding null) and adjudicated, and none is classified potential_defect: 0 findings are withheld. Reason: zero storage and no hypotheses make a REFUTED law's witness a behaviour from a state the deployment never reaches or a model artifact.

Sealed: static+AI is not_applicable on both targets (no Go document in scope, and every holon-roles-proposed/0.1 role kind names a Go document), so its decided laws equal static's by construction; the subagent is not run.
Sealed baselines: slither's compile fails on at least 1 of the 2 targets at the primary budget (the same tree as route A, no dependency tree).
Morph (contaminated) under the merged tools: role precision 4/11 and recall 4/6, equal to I104's (the merges change no file holon roles reads).

Morph under --roles auto, every law of the auto set run: 95 of the 99 decided role-dependent laws are re-derived with the same statement and status (I104's count, with I104's harness artifact on L_par_cc_BatchHeaderV1_Bytes_enc_sol_v1_pinned possibly resolved, so at least 95), and the 330 new laws are all UNKNOWN (0 decided).
